message:
Now let me understand the exact trigger. The key is:
1. The HTML document needs a non-ASCII byte (>= 0x80) to trigger `htmlCurrentChar`'s encoding detection
2. The document needs `<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=XXX">` where XXX is an unrecognized encoding

Let me check the `htmlParseErr` function to understand how the freed `guess` is used:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "htmlParseErr\b" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/HTMLparser.c | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
